description: Per-vendor commercial disclosure: whether SourcingTools.org, the publisher of SourcingBench, has a referral relationship with the vendor (i.e. may earn a fee when a reader requests a demo through SourcingTools.org). Published so readers can see the correlation between referral relationships and rankings for themselves. Referral status is disclosure metadata, not a scoring input, and is kept outside the hashed cycle files so cycle data stays immutable.
